Draft bid · Sample property 7 · Tree trimming & irrigation
From the voice note

“We’re at sample property 7, back lawn. The customer wants these two oaks trimmed back off the roofline, and the irrigation along the back bed isn’t covering — looks like the last two heads. We can do the trees this week if we get a yes. I didn’t get a clear look at lift access on the left side, so we may need to confirm that.”

Confirm lift access along the left side of the house before the crew is scheduled. The voice note did not include measurements, so none were added to the price.
Scope and price (sample)
  • Trim two live oaks off the roofline, haul cuttings$2,450
  • Replace two irrigation heads and adjust the back-bed zone$680
Total$3,130

If they pay in full: $2,980 (save $150). Or a 3-payment plan of $1,043. Sample figures only.

What you or the crew can say (not sent)

Here’s what we’ve seen, and here’s what it would cost — $3,130, or $2,980 if you pay in full. We can do it while we’re here, or schedule another time. You let us know, and we can work out a payment plan if you need one.

All you’re doing

All you’re doing is clicking a button to approve or adjust the bid that’s already completed on your behalf via . This gives you the capacity to focus on high-return activities, and less on being deep in the weeds.

In this sample, approval only moves the walkthrough forward. Nothing is emailed or texted. On a live page, you could adjust a line first.
